notes: Technical report (arXiv:2405.04434), not a system card. No dedicated safety evaluation section and no safety, refusal, jailbreak, toxicity, bias, honesty, hallucination, or dangerous-capability numeric results—evalResults left empty. Safety-adjacent content is SFT safety data, an RL safety reward model, pre-training contentious-content filtering (Appendix E), and a generic hallucination limitation; these are training methods or caveats, so topics stay uncovered per pilot rules. Skipped all capability and preference benchmarks (MMLU, BBH, HumanEval, MBPP, GSM8K, MATH, C-Eval, CMMLU, Arena-Hard/AlpacaEval/MT-Bench/AlignBench, IFEval, LiveCodeBench, NIAH, SC-Math6, etc.). Table 10 is annotator agreement on MMLU Humanity-Moral, not a model bias score. Seed-linked DeepSeek-V2.5 and DeepSeek-V2.5-1210 are not named (later releases). Open-source GitHub link given without a license name. arXiv date is publication, not a model releaseDate. Trailing empty PDF page omitted from pageCount (52).
